title: Australian Energizing Cheddar Bake
description: A hearty and energizing breakfast bake filled with australian flavors and cheddar goodness.
instructions: Prepare the baking dish with a non-stick coating.
Layer 2 slices of bread at the bottom of the dish.
Add 1/2 cup of diced onion and 1/2 cup of diced bell pepper on top of the bread.
Add 2 sliced Australian-style sausages on top of the vegetables.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped spinach on top of the sausages.
Pour 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese over the top.
Crack 2 eggs into the baking dish and mix well.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of energizing granola over the top.

Repeat the layers: 2 slices of bread, 1/2 cup of diced onion and 1/2 cup of diced bell pepper, 2 sliced Australian-style sausages, 1/2 cup of chopped spinach, 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese, 2 eggs, and 1/2 cup of energizing granola.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
